name: oracle-db-practice
description: Local Oracle Database 23ai environment for SQL practice and learning

scripts.sql: docker compose exec -it oracle sqlplus hr/hr@localhost:1521/FREEPDB1
scripts.sql:sys: docker compose exec -it oracle sqlplus sys/oracle@localhost:1521/FREEPDB1 as sysdba
scripts.db:sql: docker compose exec -it oracle sqlplus hr/hr@localhost:1521/FREEPDB1
scripts.db:sql:sys: docker compose exec -it oracle sqlplus sys/oracle@localhost:1521/FREEPDB1 as sysdba
